items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Solid, secondary, outline, ghost, link and destructive buttons with a loading state and asChild for links.
items.docs: Use asChild to render the styles on a Next Link. loading disables the button and shows a spinner.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status and metadata labels with success, warning, destructive, outline and muted tones.
items.docs: Status badges carry text as well as colour; never rely on the tone alone.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading placeholder in the shape of the content, with a shimmer sweep instead of a pulse. Give siblings a delay so the sweep runs as one wave.
items.docs: Match the real layout: a skeleton that does not hold the final shape shifts the page when the data arrives.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, decorative by default.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key for shortcut hints, with a group for combinations.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input with focus ring, invalid state and file input styling.
items.docs: Pair with Label via htmlFor. Set aria-invalid from your form library to show the error state. fieldSurface is the same surface for Textarea and the Select and Combobox triggers.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label that focuses its control on click.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A tooltip on hover and focus, with a shared provider so a row of controls feels like one surface.
items.docs: Wrap your app once in TooltipProvider. A tooltip is never the only place a label lives.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal dialog with focus trap, Escape and backdrop close, and a required title and description.
items.docs: Every DialogContent needs a DialogTitle; hide it visually with sr-only if the design has no heading.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge: menus, carts, filters. Same accessibility contract as Dialog.
items.docs: Pass side left, right, top or bottom. Sheets slide on transform only.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs with arrow-key navigation, as an underline (line) or a segmented control (pill).
items.docs: Give TabsList the group/list class so the triggers pick up the variant.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A filtered, keyboard-driven list on cmdk, inline or as a palette in CommandDialog.
items.docs: CommandDialog brings its own Command root: put CommandInput and CommandList straight inside. It carries a hidden title and description for screen readers.

items.name: rhs-ui-theme
items.title: RHS UI theme
items.description: The RHS UI colour theme: a violet brand ramp on a constant OKLCH hue and a violet-tinted neutral scale, measured for WCAG AA in light and dark. Drops into any shadcn project as the semantic tokens.
items.docs: Installs the RHS semantic tokens into your globals.css. Your components keep their names (bg-background, text-primary); only the values change.

items.title: Select

items.name: select-demo
items.title: select demo
items.description: Interactive preview of the select component.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that opens a searchable list, for choices too long to scan: countries, time zones, customers.

items.name: combobox-demo
items.title: combobox demo

items.name: textarea

items.name: textarea-demo
items.title: textarea demo

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover

items.name: popover-demo

items.name: dropdown-menu

items.name: navigation-menu

items.name: navigation-menu-demo

items.name: alert

items.name: alert-dialog-demo

items.name: animated-search
items.title: Animated search
items.description: A lens that looks left and right before it settles. For search, filter and lookup actions.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" while results are loading.

items.name: animated-arrow-right
items.title: Animated arrow right
items.description: An arrow that leaves on the right and comes back in from the left. For continue, next and call-to-action buttons.
items.docs: Place it after the label: <Button>Continue <IconArrowRightAnimated /></Button>.

items.name: animated-heart
items.title: Animated heart
items.description: A heart that beats twice, the second beat softer than the first. For favourites, wishlists and likes.

meta.usage:
<Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Save to wishlist" aria-pressed={saved}>
  <IconHeartAnimated />
</Button>

items.docs: Pair it with aria-pressed on the wishlist button; the icon only shows the gesture.

items.name: animated-sparkle
items.title: Animated sparkle
items.description: A four-point star that turns a quarter and lands on itself while the small star pops back in. For new, highlight and AI states.
items.docs: Use trigger="loop" sparingly: one moving sparkle on a page is a highlight, three is noise.

items.name: animated-refresh
items.title: Animated refresh
items.description: One eased full turn on hover, or a steady loop while something syncs.
items.docs: Switch to trigger="loop" while syncing and set aria-busy on the button; it finishes its turn when you switch back.

items.name: animated-download
items.title: Animated download
items.description: The arrow drops through the tray and comes back from the top while the tray gives a little. For download and export actions.
items.docs: Inside a download link it plays on hover and on keyboard focus of the link.

items.name: animated-trash
items.title: Animated trash
items.description: The lid lifts from its left hinge and drops shut. For delete and remove actions.
items.docs: An icon-only delete button still needs an accessible label: <Button size="icon" aria-label="Delete">.

items.name: animated-send
items.title: Animated send
items.description: A paper plane that flies off to the top right and glides back in from the bottom left. For send, share and submit.
items.docs: Plays on hover and focus of the submit button it sits in.

items.name: animated-cart
items.title: Animated cart
items.description: A product drops into the basket and the cart dips under its weight. For add-to-cart buttons and cart links.
items.docs: At rest it is the cart glyph; the product only shows while it moves.

items.name: animated-check-circle
items.title: Animated check circle
items.description: The ring draws itself and then the check. For success states, best with trigger appear.

meta.usage: Your order is confirmed.

items.docs: <IconCheckCircleAnimated trigger="appear" /> draws once when a confirmation scrolls into view.

items.name: animated-copy
items.title: Animated copy
items.description: A copy icon that turns into a drawn check while active. For confirming a copy to the clipboard.
items.docs: Set active for a moment after navigator.clipboard.writeText resolves, and announce it in a live region.

items.name: animated-menu
items.title: Animated menu
items.description: Three lines that fold into a cross while active. For the open state of a navigation menu.

meta.usage:
<Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Menu" aria-expanded={open} onClick={toggle}>
  <IconMenuAnimated active={open} />
</Button>

items.docs: Bind active to the menu's open state and aria-expanded on the button.

items.name: animated-sun-moon

meta.usage:
<Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Dark theme" aria-pressed={dark} onClick={toggleTheme}>
  <IconSunMoonAnimated active={dark} />
</Button>

items.docs: Bind active to the resolved theme after hydration, so the server and the first client render agree.

items.name: animated-settings

items.description: A gear that turns one tooth and settles while the hub gives a little. For settings and preferences.

items.name: animated-mail
items.title: Animated mail

items.name: animated-upload
items.title: Animated upload
items.description: The arrow leaves through the top and comes back from the tray, which gives under it. For upload and import actions.
items.docs: Switch to trigger="loop" while a file is uploading and set aria-busy on the button.

items.name: animated-star

meta.usage:
<Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label="Add to favourites" aria-pressed={starred}>

</Button>

items.docs: Pair it with aria-pressed on a favourite button; the icon shows the gesture, the button holds the state.

items.name: animated-log-out

items.name: animated-phone

items.name: animated-clock

items.name: animated-message
items.title: Animated message

items.name: animated-lock

items.name: animated-eye

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: Brings an element forward as it scrolls into view, tied to the scroll: rise, tilt, scale, blur or slide.
items.docs: Pure CSS scroll-driven animation: nothing is hidden before hydration, and reduced motion or a browser without scroll timelines shows the element at rest. Give a row of reveals an increasing order to land them in sequence. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.

items.name: parallax-layer
items.title: Parallax Layer
items.description: A layer that travels at its own pace while the page scrolls past, with optional zoom and turn.
items.docs: Put layers with different speeds in one relatively positioned section. Keep speeds between -0.6 and 0.6 for text, and use the stronger values for shapes and images. Clip a parent with overflow: clip, never overflow: hidden: a hidden overflow makes that parent the scroll container the timeline follows, and the animation stands still.

items.description: A statement that lights up word by word as it scrolls through the screen.
items.docs: For the one sentence a page is built around. Screen readers read the sentence whole. Give it room above and below, so the words have scroll to light up in.
